meta.name: content-repurposing
meta.description: Content atomization — turn one piece of content into many formats. Covers blog-to-thread, blog-to-carousel, podcast-to-blog, video-to-quotes, and more. Use for: content marketing, social media, multi-platform distribution, content strategy. Triggers: content repurposing, repurpose content, content atomization, content recycling, one to many content, multi platform content, cross post, adapt content, reformat content, blog to thread, blog to video, podcast to blog, content multiplication

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一篇内容自动转成多种格式分发
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需把一篇博客变成推文、视频文案等多格式内容
copy.tagline_en: Turn one piece of content into multiple formats automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to repurpose a blog into tweets, video scripts, and more

howto.what: 将一篇长内容（如博客、播客、视频）拆解成多种格式，例如 Twitter 线程、LinkedIn 轮播图、新闻简报、短视频脚本、引语卡片等。
howto.when: 当你要求“内容再利用”、“将博客转为线程”或“将播客转为博客”等时触发。

say.text: 把这篇博客文章转成 Twitter 线程。
say.note: Claude 会提取关键观点并生成线程草稿。

say.text: 将这段播客内容转成一篇博客文章。
say.note: Claude 会转录并整理成博客格式。

say.text: 从这段视频中提取 3 条引语做成引语卡片。
say.note: Claude 会生成引语卡片背景图。

howto.what_en: Turns one piece of long-form content (e.g., blog, podcast, video) into multiple formats such as Twitter threads, LinkedIn carousels, newsletter sections, short-form video scripts, and quote cards.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to 'repurpose content', 'convert blog to thread', 'turn podcast into blog', or similar requests.

say_en.text: Turn this blog post into a Twitter thread.
say_en.note: Claude extracts key insights and drafts the thread.

say_en.text: Convert this podcast episode into a blog post.
say_en.note: Claude transcribes and formats it as a blog.

say_en.text: Extract 3 quotes from this video and make quote cards.
